bd-yjf99rzx: `Cronbach_1951` is defined in both `refs.bib` and the
front-matter `references:`. Typst uses the `refs.bib` entry, so the render
succeeds with a Q-21-6 warning about the ignored inline entry.

See [@Cronbach_1951].
